about: The per-league bars production serves, statistics only (no bookmaker prices). Built by scripts/build_bars_statistics.py from config/threshold_applied.json (the applied proposal), its approval and its evidence file. Rebuild after every apply; CI --check fails when stale.

stake_plan.rule: From 2026-11-21 every TOP-3 tip carries a real stake of 0.5% of bankroll, flat, placed manually by the owner at the odds shown on the tip (nothing is executed automatically). No cell and no track stakes on its own; every other prediction carries no stake.
stake_plan.source: owner decisions 2026-11-17 ("Yes, adopt", "Show stake on TOP-3", "Use tip's odds"); config/bankroll_policy.json top3_league.stake (rule FLAT, 0.005, execution MANUAL), every cell and track at 0

not_recorded: the bars study stores no walk-forward or study counts for an OFF cell, only its reason and detail
evidence_note: WF = walk-forward: the inner out-of-sample bets of the fit window. Study = the bets at the final bar in the validation window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-08), scored once on outcomes previously seen (an earlier study had looked at them), so it is not untouched proof. Study ROI 95% CI: matchday block bootstrap. CLV = mean closing-line value of the study bets.
